headline: World Bank Provides $700 Million Support for North Macedonia: Focus on Reforms and Investments
summary: North Macedonia's finance minister and central bank governor met World Bank and IFC representatives at the Annual Meetings in Bangkok. The package focuses on reforms and investments.
why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose financing supports public budgets and infrastructure in developing and transition economies.
